30.text: The branched sclereids present in hydrophytes
30.sol: Sclereids are highly thickened dead sclerenchyma cells with very narrow cavities. They may also be branched. They provide stiffness to the parts in which they occur. Sclereids are of many types: brachysclereids, macrosclereids, osteosclereids, astrosclereids, trichosclereids and filiform sclereids. Astrosclereids are star-shaped, having various branches or arms. They are found in intercellular spaces of leaves and stems of many hydrophytes like Nymphaea.

percentage of crossing over between them
number of crossing over between them

133834.text: What is the main use of antibiotics produced by useful microbes?

304862.text: A real image of a point object located on the principal axis is produced by a convex lens. If the upper half of the lens is coated black,
options: the intensity of the image decreases.
304862.sol: When the upper half of a convex lens is coated black, the lower half of the lens remains uncovered and continues to refract the light rays from the object to form the complete image. Since the focal length and the position of the lens remain unchanged, the position of the image is unaffected according to the lens formula 1 v - 1 u = 1 f . Thus, the image does not shift.
